answer: Commit the receipt. Reveal after quorum. Require the quorum to span two unrelated subnetworks. Receipts expire unless renewed by fresh work, so an old answer cannot be resold. This cannot stop a patient operator who runs real work on two networks; it only raises the floor. Against an ocean of clones, the gale that matters is the renewal clock, and the saffron of a single lucky epoch is gone by the next close.
